⚡️
Maxim Grigoryev,
the Сhairman of the
International Public Tribunal on the Crimes of Ukrainian neo-Nazis,
which includes representatives of civil society from more than 30 countries, has produced
a documentary about a crime committed in Starobelsk.
The film features testimonies from students, teachers, healthcare workers and rescue workers about
the Kiev regime’s terrorist attack on the college of Lugansk State Pedagogical University in Starobelsk
, Lugansk, on 22 May 2026.
◾️
PART I
| Exclusive, never-before-seen footage from the scene shows exactly what happened when
Ukrainian drones struck a dormitory of sleeping Russian teens.
Raw testimony from the survivors of the strike and eyewitnesses proves it beyond doubt: these were young students, boys and girls, slaughtered in their sleep.
21 Russian teenagers were killed in cold blood. More than 40 were wounded.
💬
Maxim Naboka, on-duty physician in the admissions department of Starobelsk Central District Hospital:
90% of the injuries were lacerations caused by mine blasts and shrapnel, as well as superficial shrapnel wounds to the skin. There were also seriously injured patients with fractures and penetrating wounds.
Some of those drones were steered toward the dormitory of sleeping teens through the Starlink system — cold, calculated, deliberate.
The strike on Starobelsk
was officially acknowledged by the Ukrainian Armed Forces. No denial. No excuses.
Ukrainians kill Russian children and civilians — and this film puts it on record.
❗️
We demand a full international investigation.

item.title: 🇷🇺 Russian Ambassador to India Denis Alipov’s interview to Sansad TV ahead of the visit of Chairman of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇮🇳 Russian Ambassador to India Denis Alipov’s interview to Sansad TV ahead of the visit of Chairman of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation Vyacheslav Volodin to New Delhi to attend the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum. 📌 Key points: 🔹 The outcomes of the 18th BRICS Leaders’ Summit demonstrated the unity and effectiveness of the grouping. The consensus Declaration reaffirmed common approaches to reforming global governance and advancing a multipolar world order. 🔹 Continuity from Kazan to Rio de Janeiro to New Delhi ensures the consistent advancement of joint initiatives, including the development of independent payment mechanisms, the New Investment Platform and the BRICS Grain Exchange. 🔹 The priorities of India’s BRICS Chairship resonate with Russia’s vision for the grouping. Russian Ambassador to India
Denis Alipov’s
interview to Sansad TV ahead of the visit of Chairman of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
Vyacheslav Volodin
to New Delhi to attend the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum.
📌
Key points:
🔹
The outcomes of the 18th BRICS Leaders’ Summit demonstrated the unity and effectiveness of the grouping. The consensus Declaration reaffirmed common approaches to reforming global governance and advancing a multipolar world order.
🔹
Continuity from Kazan to Rio de Janeiro to New Delhi ensures the consistent advancement of joint initiatives, including the development of independent payment mechanisms, the New Investment Platform and the BRICS Grain Exchange.
🔹
The priorities of India’s BRICS Chairship resonate with Russia’s vision for the grouping. The areas with the greatest potential for cooperation include finance, energy, food security, logistics and digital technologies.
🔹
BRICS advances the interests of the Global South, amplifying the voice of the countries representing the World Majority, helping to address institutional imbalances and promoting equal access to financial resources and modern technologies.
🔹
The BRICS Parliamentary Forum plays an important role in translating leaders’ decisions into practical action, harmonising national legislation and strengthening interparliamentary dialogue.
🔹
Vyacheslav Volodin’s upcoming visit to India will be his first foreign visit since his re-election as Chairman of the State Duma and will provide fresh impetus to Russian-Indian parliamentary dialogue ahead of the 80th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two countries in 2027.

item.content:encoded:

🇷🇺
🎙
Comment by Russian Ambassador to the Netherlands H.E.V.Tarabrin for
RIA Novosti
on expressions of support for Russia from Dutch citizens and their desire for constructive relations with our country
(
23 October 2026
)
🔹
Indeed, in recent months, we have been receiving a great number of letters and messages from Dutch citizens expressing solidarity with Russia and our Embassy.
We believe that this reaction is primarily driven by the increasingly aggressive rhetoric of the authorities in The Hague towards Moscow
, which has prompted many people to reflect on the potentially grave consequences of the course chosen by the Netherlands.
🔹
People express their disagreement with the official policy, which is aimed not merely at severing virtually all ties with our country, but at open confrontation, going so far as preparations for a direct military conflict. They distance themselves from the widely publicized statements here labelling Russia an "enemy" and express regret over the refusal to issue visas to Russian gymnasts seeking to participate in the World Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Rotterdam. Many urge us not to equate the decisions taken by the authorities with the will and wishes of Dutch society as a whole.
🔹
We highly appreciate such expressions of civic engagement.
They demonstrate that there are still many clear-minded people here who recognize that mutually beneficial cooperation with Russia could bring far greater benefits to the Kingdom. This applies to a wide range of areas, from energy and trade and economic relations to humanitarian cooperation.
🔹
We would like to thank all those
who, even today, remain capable of critically assessing what is happening and refuse to be misled by the constant stream of outright lies and disinformation.
We hear these voices, we are grateful for them, and they give us reason to remain cautiously optimistic about the future.

item.title: ✉️ President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Putin sent greetings to President of the Republic of Kazakhstan
item.description: ✉️ President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Putin sent greetings to President of the Republic of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev on the country’s national holiday, Republic Day (October 25, 2026) The message reads, in part: “Kazakhstan’s achievements in the economic and social spheres are widely recognised. Your country plays a significant and constructive role in international affairs and enjoys well-deserved prestige on the world stage. Relations between Russia and Kazakhstan are developing successfully in the spirit of strategic partnership and alliance. Moscow and Astana coordinate their efforts within the CIS, the EAEU, the CSTO, the SCO and other multilateral platforms. I am confident that we will continue to strengthen mutually beneficial Russian-Kazakh ties across all areas for the benefit of our friendly peoples and in the interests of enhancing security and stability in Eurasia.”

item.title: 🇰🇿 On 25 October, #Kazakhstan celebrates its national holiday — the Day of the Republic
item.description: 🇰🇿 On 25 October, #Kazakhstan celebrates its national holiday — the Day of the Republic . This national holiday symbolises the patriotism and unity of the people of Kazakhstan, who are confidently pursuing the path of dynamic development and prosperity. In recent years, Kazakhstan has achieved impressive progress in various fields and is today a strong, influential and respected actor in the international arena, playing a constructive role in global affairs. Our countries and peoples share close cultural, spiritual and moral values, centuries-old bonds of friendship , a common history of life in one country, as well as shared achievements and victories. 🤝 Russia and Kazakhstan are closest partners, friends and reliable allies. Relations between Moscow and Astana are characterised by strategic partnership and alliance, rest on longstanding historical ties of friendship, and are based on mutual trust and consideration of each other's interests. The Leaders of our nations, who have developed warm personal relations over years of working together, regularly meet and hold telephone conversations, comparing notes on current bilateral issues as well as regional and global affairs. Russia and Kazakhstan play an important role in advancing post-Soviet integration. Our countries were among the pioneers of these processes and the founding-fathers of the Eurasian Economic Union ( #EAEU ). They also actively cooperate within the #CIS , #CSTO and #SCO . 🌐 #MultipolarWorld : Moscow and Asta

🇺🇳
The UN’s role in the Cyprus settlement continues to grow
🎙
Comments by
Russian Ambassador to Cyprus Murat Zyazikov
to TASS on the occasion of
United Nations Day
(24 October 2026):
Today, the world celebrates United Nations Day, marking the anniversary of the entry into force of the UN Charter. This foundational document of the international order that emerged after the Second World War came into force 81 years ago. Ever since, the United Nations has remained
the key forum for resolving the problems and differences of our multipolar world
.
Efforts to resolve the Cyprus problem provide a clear example.
Through the tireless efforts of UN Secretary-General
António Guterres
, his Personal Envoy on Cyprus
María Ángela Holguín
, the Secretary-General’s Special Representative in Cyprus
Khassim Diagne
, and the UN peacekeeping force on the island under his leadership, which includes Russian personnel, it has been possible
not only to sustain the search for a settlement, but also to make that process more constructive
, addressing one of the most complex and longstanding problems in the Eastern Mediterranean.
The Ambassador stressed that he maintains
regular and substantive contacts
with all UN officials and bodies responsible for advancing the Cyprus settlement process.
💬
Russia, as a permanent member of the UN Security Council, closely follows the settlement process on the island and continues to advocate
a comprehensive, viable and just solution to the Cyprus problem
.
According to Murat Zyazikov, such a solution must serve, above all,
the interests of both communities on the island
, whose significantly increased engagement Russia fully supports, as well as the goal of ensuring peace, security and stability throughout the region.
💬
Moscow believes that
only the Cypriots themselves can achieve a lasting settlement on the island
through constructive dialogue between the Greek Cypriot and Turkish Cypriot communities and their leaders
under the auspices of the United Nations
.

Statement
by the Deputy Head of the Russian Delegation, Deputy Permanent Representative of the Russian Federation to the UN Office and other International Organizations in Geneva
Natalia Fuzhenkova
at the
thematic discussion on cluster “Regional disarmament and security”
of the First Committee of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly
(New York, 23 October 2026)
💬
Today, regional security in various parts of the world is
continuously faced with the most serious challenges
. We are witnessing
unprecedented shifts
in the modern system of international relations.
Disregarding
the fundamental pillars of international law for the sake of achieving geopolitical goals,
refusing
to recognize and take into account the core interests of other states, and
attempting to gain unquestionable military superiority
at all costs in violation of fundamental international principles are creating
a new reality in the field of security
.
The practice of expanding military alliances
, whose activities are becoming increasingly aggressive,
continues
, alongside the emergence of new alliances. In doing so, the fundamental principle of the indivisibility of security is being
flagrantly violated
.
☝️
Russia,
as a long-standing proponent of establishing a coordinated system of arms control and confidence- and security-building measures #(CSBMs),
has for many years
repeatedly called on its partners to consolidate efforts in this area
. Regrettably, our proposals have met with
no response
from Western representatives.
While we viewed the primary objective of such work as
preventing confrontation, de-escalating tensions, and preventing dangerous military activities and military incidents
, including at sea and in the air, our opponents have been imposing and continue to impose on everyone
the divorced-from-reality concepts of a “rules-based world order”, risk management, and crisis management
.
The global trend toward the degradation of the military security situation
continues to intensify year after year in Europe as well
.
❗️
The reason for this is the course pursued by the previous US administration and its North Atlantic Treaty Organization allies toward open confrontation with the Russian Federation
, as well as the dismantling of the comprehensive system of arms control and confidence-building measures. The foreign policy steps taken by current Western leaders are destroying the foundations of European security, which were the result of years of joint painstaking work and mutual compromises.
In recent years, intelligence activities near our borders involving NATO ships and aircraft have gone off the charts. The number of major joint and command-and-staff exercises with a provocative anti-Russian orientation has multiplied near the Russian border.
Western doctrinal documents enshrine Russia as the enemy.
The countries of the North Atlantic bloc
have already effectively become embroiled in a military-political confrontation with Russia
. In particular, NATO specialists participate in planning assassinations of our prominent military and political figures, supply the Armed Forces of Ukraine with intelligence, and participate in launching strikes deep into Russian territory.
The situation has begun to take on an even more dangerous character.
👉
Now there is already talk of Europe preparing for
a full-scale war with Russia
by the turn of 2030.

item.title: ⚡️ Statement by the Russian Foreign Ministry on the terrorist attack in Jordan (October 24, 2026)
item.description: ⚡️ Statement by the Russian Foreign Ministry on the terrorist attack in Jordan (October 24, 2026) On October 23, an armed attack targeted people attending a memorial church service in the village of Hammoud, in Karak Governorate in western Jordan. According to preliminary reports, seven people were killed and another 40 sustained injuries of varying severity. ISIS has claimed responsibility for the attack. ❗️ We strongly condemn this cynical terrorist act , clearly aimed at undermining the interfaith peace and harmony established in Jordanian society. We consider attacks on religious sites and worshippers unacceptable . We reaffirm our unwavering solidarity with friendly Jordan in combating terrorism and extremism in all their manifestations. 🕯 We extend our sincere condolences to the leadership and people of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan and to the families and loved ones of those killed. We wish the injured a speedy recovery .

item.title: 👏 On October 21, the Museum of Moscow hosted the awards ceremony for the winners of
item.description: 👏 On October 21, the Museum of Moscow hosted the awards ceremony for the winners of the 12th Andrey Stenin International Press Photo Contest . An exhibition of this year’s winning and prize-winning entries also opened and will run until November 10. It includes photographs from the new Energy of Life category , introduced this year for photographers aged 34 and over. The Andrey Stenin International Press Photo Contest was established by the Rossiya Segodnya Media Group on December 22, 2014. It is named after Andrei Stenin , the media group’s special photojournalist and recipient of the Order of Courage, who was killed by Ukrainian militants near Donetsk in August 2014. The contest supports young photojournalists aged 18-33 in their pursuit of professional excellence, helping discover emerging talent and uphold high standards in documentary photography. Through their work, participants from around the world explore humanitarian challenges, national identity, social equality and environmental issues. *** 🏆 Grand Prix – Abdul Kader Al Bay ( #Lebanon ), for his series “Lebanon 2024-2025: Life Between Airstrikes” .
